atoms.title: The Keyboard Family
atoms.b: Keyboard instruments are instruments you play by pressing down keys.
atoms.sound: Keyboard instruments are instruments you play by pressing down keys.

atoms.b: The keys are usually played with your ((++hands feet)). You can easily play many notes at the same time.
A tone is produced indirectly via the ((++keys strings)). Because the insides of different keyboard instruments vary, they also produce sounds differently when their keys are pressed.
With a harpsichord, tones are created by the plucking of strings inside the instrument when a key is pressed. With a piano, the strings are struck with little hammers when a key is pressed.
atoms.sound: With a harpsichord, tones are created by the plucking of strings inside the instrument when a key is pressed. With a piano, the strings are struck with little hammers when a key is pressed.

atoms.b: With the organ and the accordion, sound is created by an air current that passes through the instrument.
atoms.sound: With an organ and the accordion, sound is created by an air current that passes through the instrument.

atoms.a: How is sound created with a harpsichord when a key is pressed?
b: through the striking of the strings

atoms.a: How about with an organ and an accordion?
b: through the plucking of the strings
through the striking of the strings
